name: Duvadilan 10mg Tablet 50'S
introduction:
Introduction About DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET

DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

mechanismOfAction:
How DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET Works

DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET manages premature labor by managing the contractions of the smooth muscles in the uterus. In peripheral vascular disease, it helps in widening of blood vessels to increase blood flow, thereby improving blood circulation to certain parts of the body (such as the hands/feet and brain).
usageDetails:
How to use DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET

Take DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. The correct dose and duration will be decided by your physician for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Allergic reaction (symptoms like difficulty breathing, closing of the throat, swelling of the lips, tongue or face, hives)
Restarting of contractions or breaking of water

Dizziness, weakness

Stop taking DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Rash
Restarting of contractions or breaking of water

warnings.details: DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary as it is not known whether this medicine will be harmful to an unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary as it is not known whether this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive, use any machines or do anything that needs attention if you feel sleepy or dizzy after taking DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET.
Do not take DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Isoxsuprine, lactose or some sugars or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases, especially arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat). Consult your physician before taking it.

Others

DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
Have chorioamnionitis (infection of the amniotic fluid and tissue around the baby during pregnancy)
Have bleeding problems
Have eclampsia or preeclampsia (high blood pressure problems during pregnancy)
Just had a baby (immediately postpartum)

Before taking DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Smoke tobacco
Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)

Use in pediatrics:

Safety and effectiveness of DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET in children have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

No specific information is available on the use of DUVADILAN 10MG TABLET in elderly patients. It may reduce tolerance to cold temperatures in these patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Stiloz 50mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About STILOZ 50MG TABLET

STILOZ 50MG TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STILOZ 50MG TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How STILOZ 50MG TABLET Works

STILOZ 50MG TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.
usageDetails:
How to use STILOZ 50MG TABLET

Take STILOZ 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow STILOZ 50MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.
STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate heavy machines if you experience dizziness while taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.
STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.
STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.
Do not take STILOZ 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Cilostazol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, had heart attack, persistent chest pain at rest, any heart surgery in the last 6 months, suffered from blackouts due to heart disease or any severe disturbances of the heartbeat. It should be taken with caution in patients with severe heart problem or any other problems with your heart beat and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.
STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
STILOZ 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET.

Others

STILOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any condition which increases the risk of bleeding or bruising, such as active stomach ulcers, stroke in the past six months, eye problems with diabetes and uncontrolled blood pressure

Before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Need to have surgery (including teeth removal)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) (used to manage painful inflammatory condition of muscle or joints)
Anticoagulant medicines (Ex. heparin, warfarin, clopidogrel, dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban) (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Certain antibiotics Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin or rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Omeprazole (used to manage acidity in the stomach)
Diltiazem (used to manage high blood pressure or chest pain)
Cisapride (used to manage stomach disorders)
Medicines used to manage high cholesterol in the blood (Ex. lovastatin, simvastatin)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Protease inhibitors such as atazanavir, darunavir (used to manage HIV infection)
Pimozide (used to manage mental illnesses)
Ergot derivatives Ex. ergotamine, dihydroergotamine (used to manage or manage migraine headaches)
St. john’s wort (herbal remedy), carbamazepine or phenytoin (used to manage convulsions)
Diuretics Ex. hydrochlorothiazide, furosemide (used to manage fluid retention)
Calcium channel blockers such as verapamil, amlodipine, angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitors such as captopril, lisinopril, angiotensin II receptor blockers such as valsartan, candesartan and beta blockers such as labetalol, carvedilol (used to manage high blood pressure)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking STILOZ 50MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine and do not take together with meals as it may affects its absorption and increase the risk of side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of STILOZ 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of STILOZ 50MG TABLET includes severe headache, diarrhea, increase in heart rate and irregularities of the heartbeat.

introduction:
Introduction About CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET

CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET Works

CILOSTOZ 100 TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.

name: Nicerbium 30mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET

NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET contain Nicergoline which belongs to a group of medicine called Nootropic agents. NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET is used to manage cerebrovascular insufficiency (insufficient blood flow to the brain) and dementia (loss of cognitive functions) that occurs in old age.

NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET is also used as a peripheral vasodilator to manage vascular (blood vessel) disorders (such as cerebral thrombosis, atherosclerosis, diabetic retinopathy, macular degeneration, and retinal Angio sclerosis) in affected individuals. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage migraine, and Raynaud’s phenomenon (condition marked by reduced blood flow to the fingers).  

NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic (hypersensitive) to Nicergoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from acute bleeding, orthostatic dysregulation (impaired regulation of orthostatic blood pressure). It is also not indicated for use in patients suffering from heart diseases (such as recent myocardial infarction/severe bradycardia).

Before taking NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, hyperuricemia (excess uric acid in blood), gout (inflammatory joint), liver problems, and/or kidney problems (such as impaired renal function).

NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effect associated with the use of NICERBIUM 30MG TABLET is abdominal discomfort. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

name: GESTAKIND SR Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About GESTAKIND SR TABLET

GESTAKIND SR TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

GESTAKIND SR TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

GESTAKIND SR TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. GESTAKIND SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking GESTAKIND SR TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take GESTAKIND SR TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of GESTAKIND SR TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with GESTAKIND SR TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking GESTAKIND SR TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

mechanismOfAction:
How GESTAKIND SR TABLET Works

GESTAKIND SR TABLET manages premature labor by managing the contractions of the smooth muscles in the uterus. In peripheral vascular disease, it helps in widening of blood vessels to increase blood flow, thereby improving blood circulation to certain parts of the body (such as the hands/feet and brain).

Take GESTAKIND SR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. The correct dose and duration will be decided by your physician for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not take GESTAKIND SR TABLET if you are allergic to Isoxsuprine, lactose or some sugars or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)

No specific information is available on the use of GESTAKIND SR TABLET in elderly patients. It may reduce tolerance to cold temperatures in these patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Stozic 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About STOZIC 100MG TABLET

STOZIC 100MG TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

STOZIC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking STOZIC 100MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. STOZIC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking STOZIC 100MG TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STOZIC 100MG TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How STOZIC 100MG TABLET Works

STOZIC 100MG TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.
usageDetails:
How to use STOZIC 100MG TABLET

Take STOZIC 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow STOZIC 100MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking VASCILOL 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) (used to manage painful inflammatory condition of muscle or joints)
Anticoagulant medicines (Ex. heparin, warfarin, clopidogrel, dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban) (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Certain antibiotics Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin or rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Omeprazole (used to manage acidity in the stomach)
Diltiazem (used to manage high blood pressure or chest pain)
Cisapride (used to manage stomach disorders)
Medicines used to manage high cholesterol in the blood (Ex. lovastatin, simvastatin)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Protease inhibitors such as atazanavir, darunavir (used to manage HIV infection)
Pimozide (used to manage mental illnesses)
Ergot derivatives Ex. ergotamine, dihydroergotamine (used to manage or manage migraine headaches)
St. john’s wort (herbal remedy), carbamazepine or phenytoin (used to manage convulsions)
Diuretics Ex. hydrochlorothiazide, furosemide (used to manage fluid retention)
Calcium channel blockers such as verapamil, amlodipine, angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitors such as captopril, lisinopril, angiotensin II receptor blockers such as valsartan, candesartan and beta blockers such as labetalol, carvedilol (used to manage high blood pressure)

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking VASCILOL 50MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine and do not take together with meals as it may affects its absorption and increase the risk of side effects.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of VASCILOL 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of VASCILOL 50MG TABLET includes severe headache, diarrhea, increase in heart rate and irregularities of the heartbeat.

name: Zilast 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZILAST 50MG TABLET

ZILAST 50MG TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

ZILAST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking ZILAST 50MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. ZILAST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking ZILAST 50MG TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZILAST 50MG TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How ZILAST 50MG TABLET Works

ZILAST 50MG TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.

introduction:
Introduction About SELEPEG 200 TABLET

SELEPEG 200 TABLET contains Selexipag, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Prostacyclin Receptor Agonists. It is used for the long-term management of Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH - a condition with increased pressure due to the narrowing of blood vessels supplying the lungs from the heart lungs) in adults. The symptoms of PAH may include dizziness, tiredness, shortness of breath, swelling in the ankles and legs, chest pain, heart failure, etc.

SELEPEG 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with coronary heart disease (poor blood supply to heart muscles, unstable angina (chest pain), weak heart (decompensated heart failure), a history of heart attack within the past 6 months, congenital or acquired heart valve disease, severe arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat).

SELEPEG 200 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with narrowing of the pulmonary vein, a condition called pulmonary venous-occlusive disease, severe liver disease, severe kidney disease, low blood pressure (hypotension) with dizziness and hyperthyroidism.

SELEPEG 200 TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers and children less than 18 years of age. SELEPEG 200 TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under the age of 18 years. SELEPEG 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients above 75 years of age.

The side effects of taking SELEPEG 200 TABLET may include headache, flushing (reddening of the face), nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, jaw pain, muscle pain, joint pain, nasopharyngitis (stuffy nose), anaemia, weight loss, rashes, stomach pain, hypotension (low blood pressure), hyperthyroidism, tachycardia (increased heart rate), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SELEPEG 200 TABLET
Manage Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
mechanismOfAction:
How SELEPEG 200 TABLET Works

SELEPEG 200 TABLET works similarly to a natural substance present in our body (Prostacyclin) by widening the pulmonary arteries and reducing their hardness. Doing so makes it easier for the heart to pump blood to the lungs effectively. It also decreases pressure in pulmonary arteries, hence reducing the symptoms of pulmonary arterial hypertension and slowing down the progression of the disease. The metabolite released by SELEPEG 200 TABLET has vasodilatory, anti-proliferative and anti-fibrotic effects.
usageDetails:
How to use SELEPEG 200 TABLET

Take SELEPEG 200 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your management dose and duration will be decided by your physician depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CILODOC 100 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About CILODOC 100 TABLET

CILODOC 100 TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

CILODOC 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking CILODOC 100 TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. CILODOC 100 TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking CILODOC 100 TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILODOC 100 TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How CILODOC 100 TABLET Works

CILODOC 100 TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.

Take CILODOC 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow CILODOC 100 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Zilast 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZILAST 100MG TABLET

ZILAST 100MG TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

ZILAST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking ZILAST 100MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. ZILAST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking ZILAST 100MG TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZILAST 100MG TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How ZILAST 100MG TABLET Works

ZILAST 100MG TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.
usageDetails:
How to use ZILAST 100MG TABLET

Take ZILAST 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ZILAST 100MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STILOZ 100MG TABLET

STILOZ 100MG TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

STILOZ 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking STILOZ 100MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. STILOZ 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking STILOZ 100MG TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STILOZ 100MG TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How STILOZ 100MG TABLET Works

STILOZ 100MG TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.

Take STILOZ 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow STILOZ 100MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Pletoz 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PLETOZ 100MG TABLET

PLETOZ 100MG TABLET contains Cilostazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitors. It is used in the management of intermittent claudication, which is defined as the cramp-like pain in the legs while walking caused by insufficient blood supply in the legs. Symptoms include pain, ache, discomfort or fatigue in muscles every time, when those muscles are used (usually the calves, thighs, buttocks, hips or feet).

Along with this management your doctor might advise you to make lifestyle modifications like increasing regular exercise and stop smoking. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take ankle-brachial index test to understand your existing condition.

PLETOZ 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart problems (such as heart failure, heart attack), uncontrolled blood pressure, kidney or liver disease, active stomach ulcer and stroke.

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking PLETOZ 100MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine. PLETOZ 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking PLETOZ 100MG TABLET are headache, abnormal stools, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, dizziness, nausea and loss of appetite.  Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PLETOZ 100MG TABLET
Manage intermittent claudication
mechanismOfAction:
How PLETOZ 100MG TABLET Works

PLETOZ 100MG TABLET acts by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (phosphodiesterase) which helps in the increase in the level of cAMP (cellular messengers to initiate certain actions) in platelets and blood vessels. The cAMP helps in widening of some blood vessels and reducing the clotting activity of platelets inside the blood vessels. Hence increasing the blood circulation to the legs making it easier and less painful to walk.
usageDetails:
How to use PLETOZ 100MG TABLET

Take PLETOZ 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow PLETOZ 100MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking PLETOZ 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) (used to manage painful inflammatory condition of muscle or joints)
Anticoagulant medicines (Ex. heparin, warfarin, clopidogrel, dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban) (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Certain antibiotics Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin or rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Omeprazole (used to manage acidity in the stomach)
Diltiazem (used to manage high blood pressure or chest pain)
Cisapride (used to manage stomach disorders)
Medicines used to manage high cholesterol in the blood (Ex. lovastatin, simvastatin)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Protease inhibitors such as atazanavir, darunavir (used to manage HIV infection)
Pimozide (used to manage mental illnesses)
Ergot derivatives Ex. ergotamine, dihydroergotamine (used to manage or manage migraine headaches)
St. john’s wort (herbal remedy), carbamazepine or phenytoin (used to manage convulsions)
Diuretics Ex. hydrochlorothiazide, furosemide (used to manage fluid retention)
Calcium channel blockers such as verapamil, amlodipine, angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitors such as captopril, lisinopril, angiotensin II receptor blockers such as valsartan, candesartan and beta blockers such as labetalol, carvedilol (used to manage high blood pressure)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Do not drink large amounts of grapefruit juice while taking PLETOZ 100MG TABLET as it may reduce the effect of this medicine and do not take together with meals as it may affects its absorption and increase the risk of side effects.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of PLETOZ 100MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of PLETOZ 100MG TABLET includes severe headache, diarrhea, increase in heart rate and irregularities of the heartbeat.

name: IDILAN 10mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About IDILAN 10MG TABLET

IDILAN 10MG TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

IDILAN 10MG TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

IDILAN 10MG TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. IDILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking IDILAN 10MG TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take IDILAN 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of IDILAN 10MG TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with IDILAN 10MG TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking IDILAN 10MG TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

How IDILAN 10MG TABLET Works

IDILAN 10MG TABLET manages premature labor by managing the contractions of the smooth muscles in the uterus. In peripheral vascular disease, it helps in widening of blood vessels to increase blood flow, thereby improving blood circulation to certain parts of the body (such as the hands/feet and brain).

Take IDILAN 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. The correct dose and duration will be decided by your physician for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: IDILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary as it is not known whether this medicine will be harmful to an unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.

IDILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary as it is not known whether this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive, use any machines or do anything that needs attention if you feel sleepy or dizzy after taking IDILAN 10MG TABLET.
Do not take IDILAN 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Isoxsuprine, lactose or some sugars or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
IDILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases, especially arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat). Consult your physician before taking it.

Others

IDILAN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
Have chorioamnionitis (infection of the amniotic fluid and tissue around the baby during pregnancy)
Have bleeding problems
Have eclampsia or preeclampsia (high blood pressure problems during pregnancy)
Just had a baby (immediately postpartum)

Before taking IDILAN 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Smoke tobacco
Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)

Use in pediatrics:

Safety and effectiveness of IDILAN 10MG TABLET in children have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

No specific information is available on the use of IDILAN 10MG TABLET in elderly patients. It may reduce tolerance to cold temperatures in these patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET

GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking GESTAKIND 10MG TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

In peripheral vascular disease, it helps in widening of blood vessels to increase blood flow, thereby improving blood circulation to certain parts of the body (such as the hands/feet and brain).

introduction:
Introduction About IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET

IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking IDILAN SR 40MG TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

In peripheral vascular disease, it helps in widening of blood vessels to increase blood flow, thereby improving blood circulation to certain parts of the body (such as the hands/feet and brain).

introduction:
Introduction About UDILAN SR TABLET

UDILAN SR TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

UDILAN SR TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

UDILAN SR TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. UDILAN SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking UDILAN SR TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take UDILAN SR TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of UDILAN SR TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with UDILAN SR TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking UDILAN SR TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

name: ZEXIPAG 400 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET

ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET contains Selexipag, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Prostacyclin Receptor Agonists. It is used for the long-term management of Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH - a condition with increased pressure due to the narrowing of blood vessels supplying the lungs from the heart lungs) in adults. The symptoms of PAH may include dizziness, tiredness, shortness of breath, swelling in the ankles and legs, chest pain, heart failure, etc.

ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with coronary heart disease (poor blood supply to heart muscles, unstable angina (chest pain), weak heart (decompensated heart failure), a history of heart attack within the past 6 months, congenital or acquired heart valve disease, severe arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat).

ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with narrowing of the pulmonary vein, a condition called pulmonary venous-occlusive disease, severe liver disease, severe kidney disease, low blood pressure (hypotension) with dizziness and hyperthyroidism.

ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers and children less than 18 years of age. ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under the age of 18 years. ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET should be used with caution in patients above 75 years of age.

The side effects of taking ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET may include headache, flushing (reddening of the face), nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, jaw pain, muscle pain, joint pain, nasopharyngitis (stuffy nose), anaemia, weight loss, rashes, stomach pain, hypotension (low blood pressure), hyperthyroidism, tachycardia (increased heart rate), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET
Manage Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET Works

ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET works similarly to a natural substance present in our body (Prostacyclin) by widening the pulmonary arteries and reducing their hardness. Doing so makes it easier for the heart to pump blood to the lungs effectively. It also decreases pressure in pulmonary arteries, hence reducing the symptoms of pulmonary arterial hypertension and slowing down the progression of the disease. The metabolite released by ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET has vasodilatory, anti-proliferative and anti-fibrotic effects.

How to use ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET

Take ZEXIPAG 400 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your management dose and duration will be decided by your physician depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

UTORAX 10 TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

UTORAX 10 TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. UTORAX 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking UTORAX 10 TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take UTORAX 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of UTORAX 10 TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with UTORAX 10 TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking UTORAX 10 TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

name: ZEXIPAG 200 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET

ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET contains Selexipag, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Prostacyclin Receptor Agonists. It is used for the long-term management of Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH - a condition with increased pressure due to the narrowing of blood vessels supplying the lungs from the heart lungs) in adults. The symptoms of PAH may include dizziness, tiredness, shortness of breath, swelling in the ankles and legs, chest pain, heart failure, etc.

ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with coronary heart disease (poor blood supply to heart muscles, unstable angina (chest pain), weak heart (decompensated heart failure), a history of heart attack within the past 6 months, congenital or acquired heart valve disease, severe arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat).

ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with narrowing of the pulmonary vein, a condition called pulmonary venous-occlusive disease, severe liver disease, severe kidney disease, low blood pressure (hypotension) with dizziness and hyperthyroidism.

ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers and children less than 18 years of age. ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under the age of 18 years. ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients above 75 years of age.

The side effects of taking ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET may include headache, flushing (reddening of the face), nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, jaw pain, muscle pain, joint pain, nasopharyngitis (stuffy nose), anaemia, weight loss, rashes, stomach pain, hypotension (low blood pressure), hyperthyroidism, tachycardia (increased heart rate), etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET
Manage Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET Works

ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET works similarly to a natural substance present in our body (Prostacyclin) by widening the pulmonary arteries and reducing their hardness. Doing so makes it easier for the heart to pump blood to the lungs effectively. It also decreases pressure in pulmonary arteries, hence reducing the symptoms of pulmonary arterial hypertension and slowing down the progression of the disease. The metabolite released by ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET has vasodilatory, anti-proliferative and anti-fibrotic effects.
usageDetails:
How to use ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET

Take ZEXIPAG 200 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your management dose and duration will be decided by your physician depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Affects the blood test results, including the blood cell counts or thyroid function test
Rashes and hives may cause a burning or stinging sensation and skin redness

ADILIN SR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary as it is not known whether this medicine will be harmful to an unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Breastfeeding

ADILIN SR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary as it is not known whether this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive, use any machines or do anything that needs attention if you feel sleepy or dizzy after taking ADILIN SR 40 TABLET.

Allergy

Do not take ADILIN SR 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Isoxsuprine, lactose or some sugars or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease

ADILIN SR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases, especially arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat). Consult your physician before taking it.

Others

ADILIN SR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
Have chorioamnionitis (infection of the amniotic fluid and tissue around the baby during pregnancy)
Have bleeding problems
Have eclampsia or preeclampsia (high blood pressure problems during pregnancy)
Just had a baby (immediately postpartum)

Before taking ADILIN SR 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Smoke tobacco
Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)

Use in pediatrics:

Safety and effectiveness of ADILIN SR 40 TABLET in children have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

No specific information is available on the use of ADILIN SR 40 TABLET in elderly patients. It may reduce tolerance to cold temperatures in these patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET

TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET contains Isoxsuprine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used in the management of premature labor (when the uterus starts contracting for birth too early than usual), cerebral vascular insufficiency (poor blood flow to the brain) and arteriosclerosis obliterans (hardening of the arteries).

TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET can also be used to manage Buerger's disease (blood vessels become inflamed, swollen and can become blocked with blood clots), Raynaud’s phenomenon (decreased blood flow to the nose, ears, fingers, toes, nipples or knees) and dysmenorrhea (painful menstrual cramps).

TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET should not be used immediately after delivering a baby or if you have a bleeding disorder. TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have any heart disease (especially arrhythmias), hyperthyroidism, chorioamnionitis, bleeding, eclampsia or pre-eclampsia.

Avoid smoking and consuming alcohol while taking TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET as it may cause dizziness. Do not take TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Safety and effectiveness of TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET in children have not been established.

Your doctor may want you to take blood tests or other medical evaluations during management with TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET to monitor progress and side effects. The most common side effects of taking TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET are chest pain or an irregular heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, dizziness or weakness. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

mechanismOfAction:
How TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET Works

TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET manages premature labor by managing the contractions of the smooth muscles in the uterus. In peripheral vascular disease, it helps in widening of blood vessels to increase blood flow, thereby improving blood circulation to certain parts of the body (such as the hands/feet and brain).

How to use TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET

Take TIDILAN RETARD 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. The correct dose and duration will be decided by your physician for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
